# Full-name subscription labels keep their escaped UTF-8 decoding branch

GetLeafName first resolves its subscription node. When mShowFullName is true, it unescapes aPath with ESCAPE_URL_FILE_BASENAME | ESCAPE_URL_FORCED, converts UTF-8 to UTF-16 and returns NS_OK. The other branch uses CopyFolderNameToUTF16 on the node name. The local comment distinguishes full escaped news paths from IMAP node names that may use modified UTF-7. Removing NS_MsgDecodeUnescapeURLPath inlines these same operations; it does not add error propagation or make one decoder suitable for both branches. No new test, live subscription UI or server execution was performed.

Scope: mailnews-subscriptions.
